author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Create, audit, and reset per-game profiles
summary: Keep global defaults clean, store only justified game-specific overrides, record the problem each solves, and reset a profile without disturbing saves or other titles.
heroAlt: EmuCoreX Game Manager displaying per-game video, system, and control tabs

blocks.text: An override should answer one documented problem

Global settings define the expected behaviour for the whole library. A per-game profile is valuable when one serial needs a renderer, resolution, controller layout or verified fix that would harm other titles. Profiles become dangerous when copied wholesale from videos, because stale overrides keep acting after the original issue or device has changed.
Before editing, reset the target game to inherited Safe defaults and verify the problem still exists. Change one tab at a time and leave unrelated values inherited.

Record game title, serial, region, current global profile and the exact failing scene. Back up controls or patches that are genuinely game-specific. Confirm that memory cards and states live outside the settings reset scope.

items: Exact game serial and region.
Reproducible issue under global Safe defaults.
Screenshot of current override tabs.
Known method to reset only this game.
Durable in-game save for testing.
1. Open Game Manager for the exact library entry and reset inherited/override state to the documented default.
2. Reproduce the issue and choose the single subsystem tab that owns it: Video, System & Performance, or Controls.
3. Apply one evidence-backed change, relaunch from a cold boot and replay the same scene.
4. If it passes, test a second scene and record the reason beside the profile; if it fails, revert before trying another variable.
5. Return to another game and confirm its effective settings still match the global profile.

blocks.text: The profile must solve the named issue across two cold starts and remain correct after a global setting changes. Inspect each tab for hidden overrides: a profile that appears minimal in Video can still carry old CPU or control values elsewhere.

items: Only justified fields differ from global defaults.
Exact serial/region is recorded.
Target and second scene pass.
Another game remains unaffected.
Reset path preserves saves and library metadata.

blocks.text: Use Reset all settings for this game or the equivalent profile reset, then cold-start under global Safe defaults. Reapply only exported controls or verified patches that are independent of the failed experiment. Do not clear application data to remove one profile.

items: Capture the current profile for diagnosis.
Reset only the selected game.
Verify global defaults on cold boot.
Restore a single proven override if still required.
Fix stops working after region change: profile attached to a different serial.
Other games regress: global setting was edited instead of an override.
Reset seems incomplete: another tab still contains overrides.
Copied profile has many changes: no causal evidence for any one of them.

blocks.text: Audit profiles after major app, core or Android changes. Remove overrides whose original fault no longer reproduces. A small collection of explained exceptions stays maintainable; a large collection of copied settings becomes a second, invisible emulator configuration.
